topic: How do interference mitigation techniques adapt when handling tunneled versus non-tunneled traffic in multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Interference mitigation techniques adapt by employing rate-splitting multiple access frameworks, managing inter-beam interference considering CSIT uncertainty and per-feed constraints. This approach optimizes radio resource allocation and satcom network operations, enabling coexistence with terrestrial systems and improving overall system performance.
reference_context: Rate-splitting multiple access frameworks show promise for multibeam satellite systems, addressing inter-beam interference and practical challenges.
